# Linux discovery then local account creation

Version 1\.0\.0 · VERIFIED · chained

List the running processes on the endpoint\, then create a local account and remove it again\, the second step started once the platform has started the first\: a short chain from process discovery \(T1057\) to a local account \(T1078\.003\)\. The second step runs on Linux only\, and the agent must run as root\; an account named art that already exists is left as it is\.

## Steps

### 1\. Step 1 \- list processes

- Starts when the scenario is launched.
- Injector: openaev\_implant
- Payload: Process Discovery \- ps \(1\.1\.0\) \(c297e3ae\-0cc2\-5500\-a923\-1d0d7c1f67df\)

Command (sh):

```
ps aux | tail -n +2
```

### 2\. Create local account

- Waits for: step 1.
- Injector: openaev\_implant
- Payload: Create local account \(1\.1\.0\) \(ca055711\-870c\-5a47\-8539\-a14fb60893e8\)

Command (bash):

```
dir=/var/tmp/openaev-created-art
id art >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "an account named art already exists: nothing is created" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -m 711 "$dir" 2>/dev/null || { echo "$dir already exists: nothing is created" >&2; exit 1; }
password=$(openssl passwd -1 art) || { rmdir "$dir"; exit 1; }
useradd --shell /bin/bash --home-dir "$dir/home" --create-home --password "$password" art || { rm -rf "$dir"; exit 1; }
id -u art > "$dir/uid" || { userdel art; rm -rf "$dir"; exit 1; }
su art -c "whoami; exit"
```

Cleanup (bash):

```
dir=/var/tmp/openaev-created-art
if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$dir")" = 0 ]; then
  if [ -f "$dir/uid" ] && [ ! -L "$dir/uid" ] && [ "$(id -u art 2>/dev/null)" = "$(cat "$dir/uid")" ]; then
    userdel art
  fi
  rm -rf "$dir"
fi
```
